stem.en:
No net force acts on an object. Which of these are possible?

(i) It stays at rest, if it was at rest.
(ii) It keeps moving with a constant velocity, if it was moving.
(iii) It moves with a constant acceleration.

feedback.en: A moving object with no net force does not stop. It keeps its velocity, so (ii) is possible too.
Right. With no net force, the velocity does not change: it stays zero, or it stays constant.
An acceleration needs a net force. With no net force, (iii) is not possible.

explanation.en: With no net force, the acceleration is zero. The object stays at rest or keeps moving with a constant velocity. A constant acceleration would need a net force.

hints.en: With no net force, what is the acceleration?
